annotations.text:
Direction: the footage leads.

The app currently reads as a settings list that happens to hold video — 52px thumbnails in grouped rows. Here the moments are the interface: poster cards on the list, a filmstrip in the editor, preview as the hero rather than a nav-bar button.

Brand is unchanged: amber #E08700 (#FFB020 dark), the 160° amber-to-ember gradient, burnt orange #C2410C for interactive text in light mode. Capture stays black and unbranded — a viewfinder covered in brand colour is a worse viewfinder.

New surfaces on this row.

Export becomes a sheet with two choices rather than one button: the whole Glimpse as video, or the frame under the playhead as a JPEG still. The still option shows which frame it will save.

Organise previews the resulting order before you commit, because shuffling 38 moments you cannot see is a leap of faith. Shuffle reshuffles on each tap.

Alternate axis: instead of one cover frame per Glimpse, show the actual strip of moments, so the shape of the whole video is legible from the list.

Tradeoff: far more scannable for long Glimpses, but it loses the poster quality that makes a Glimpse feel like a finished piece, and three per screen instead of four.
